paper_title: AI-based screening for thoracic aortic aneurysms in routine breast MRI
prediction_task: Thoracic aortic aneurysm detection from routine breast MRI scans

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Algorithm has to be assessed in a prospective huge dataset of multi-institutions. The Erlangen dataset carries too many breast cancer patients and does not reflect a normal population.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Discussed prospective validation plans and population representativeness.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Number of diagnosed aneurysms was very low. Did any diagnosed aneurysm have further assessment with CT/angiography or treatment? What would be the consequence of such a diagnosis for a woman? Incidence higher in breast cancer group — any explanations?
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added clinical follow-up data for detected aneurysms and discussed cancer-aortic association.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: How long does analysis take per case? How could the analysis be included in reporting workflow? Could the algorithm also be used for lung cancer screening CT as a blueprint?
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added inference time analysis and discussed broader screening applications.

reviewer_strengths.text: Huge dataset (N=5153) from multiple sites with mix of MRI manufacturers and field strengths makes it very interesting and robust. Impressive numbers.
